title: Templator
excerpt: AI-first Next.js template for rapid development with authentication, database, and Cloudflare Workers deployment

data.text: Templator is a Next.js 15 template optimized for AI-assisted development. It includes complete authentication with Better Auth (email/password, email verification, password reset), 3-tier RBAC system (user/editor/admin), Drizzle ORM with Neon PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Workers deployment with zero cold starts. Full stack with React 19, strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, email system with React Email, built-in blog, contact form and newsletter.
